# LexVault eDiscovery: renewal notice
Date: 2026-10-30

Current plan: $3,950 a month, 2 terabytes of hosted review.
Renewal price: $4,660 a month starting December 1, 2026, an 18% increase.
Auto-renewal: The contract renews for 12 months unless the firm gives written notice at least 15 days before December 1, so by November 16, 2026.

Usage in 2026: Only 3 matters used LexVault this year. Hosting in the last 6 months averaged 0.6 terabytes. Two of the three matters are closed.

Teresa's note: Per-matter hosting would have cost about $1,100 a month this year. Renewal would cost $55,920 for the year.
